I still have miles to go before I can truly call myself ready for training others back home, but this month has proven I can handle complexity without losing sight of what needs to be respected: nature's own timeline.

Now, it’s time to think about the road ahead. Buttons is strong, and my skills are proving dependable. The next step isn't just survival; it's strategic movement. Time to see if those letters of introduction hold any real weight in Goldwise or out on the far side... I need that gold for a proper bath, but more than that, I need connections. I have work now, and I have direction.
